blocks.en: A ice belt, full of lovely frozen stuff.
blocks.zh: 一条冰矿带，满是可爱的冰冻物质。

blocks.en: Ice harvesting is the process of obtaining resources from ice fields (commonly called "ice belts"). This mined ice can then be refined and used to fuel capital ship jump drives, manufacture fuel for player-owned starbases and structure services, and light cynosural fields. Ice harvesting requires specialized modules or drones, and so is generally only performed by the same ships used for regular mining: Mining Barges and Exhumers, Expedition Frigates, Industrial Command Ships, the Rorqual, the Capital Industrial Ship.
blocks.zh: 冰矿采集是从冰矿区（通常称为“冰矿带”）获取资源的过程。采到的冰矿可以提炼，用作旗舰跳跃引擎的燃料，制造玩家自建空间站（POS）和建筑服务所用的燃料，以及开启诱导力场。冰矿采集需要专门的装备或无人机，因此一般只由常规采矿所用的那些舰船进行：采矿驳船和采掘者、勘探护卫舰、工业指挥舰，以及旗舰级工业舰长须鲸级。

blocks.en: Unlike the various ore mining tools, ice harvesting tools always harvest one block of ice (with a volume of 1,000 m3) per cycle; because of this, the best method of harvesting ice more efficiently is to decrease the ice harvesters' cycle times.
blocks.zh: 与各种矿石采矿工具不同，冰矿采集工具每个周期总是采集一块冰矿（体积 1,000 m3）；因此，提高冰矿采集效率的最佳方法是缩短冰矿采集器的周期时间。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: The Odyssey expansion (June 2013) changed ice mining considerably. Before the expansion, ice belts were permanent features in a system, with thousands of ice asteroids spread over hundreds of kilometers. This was changed to much smaller (10–20 ice asteroids each with 50–200 units of ice) dynamic belts which disappear once mined out, and then respawn four hours later. The Gateway release (September 2021) then increased the respawn time to six hours.
blocks.zh: 奥德赛（Odyssey）资料片（2013 年 6 月）大幅改变了冰矿开采。在该资料片之前，冰矿带是星系中的永久地貌，成千上万颗冰矿小行星分布在数百公里范围内。改版后变成了规模小得多的动态冰矿带（10–20 颗冰矿小行星，每颗含 50–200 单位冰矿），采空后消失，四小时后重新刷新。之后Gateway 版本（2021 年 9 月）又把刷新时间延长到了六小时。

blocks.en: Advantages
blocks.zh: 优点

en: Reduced attention required by the miner when compared with ore mining.
Ability to be self-sufficient for POS fuel.
Easier to mine without a dedicated hauler (longer cycle times mean fewer trips to the station).
Fun factor of 6-hourly 'Ice Rush' when a belt spawns, as dozens of miners rush in to clear the belt.
zh: 与矿石采矿相比，矿工需要投入的注意力更少。
可以自给自足 POS 燃料。
没有专职运输也更容易开采（周期更长，意味着回站次数更少）。
每 6 小时一次的“冰矿热潮”很有乐趣：冰矿带刷新时，几十名矿工蜂拥而至，把冰矿带清空。

blocks.en: Disadvantages
blocks.zh: 缺点

en: Reduced ISK yield compared to ore mining. While ice commands similar prices to ore, it's not possible to mine ice continuously due to the 6 hour respawn timer on ice belts.
zh: 与矿石采矿相比，ISK 收益较低。虽然冰矿的价格与矿石相近，但由于冰矿带有 6 小时的刷新计时，无法持续开采冰矿。

blocks.en: Ice belts
blocks.zh: 冰矿带

blocks.en: A map of the Metropolis region from dotlan. The Eygfe system has an ice belt, as shown by the thin blue ring around its box.
blocks.zh: 来自 dotlan 的美特伯里斯星域地图。伊戈菲 星系有一条冰矿带，其方框周围的细蓝圈表明了这一点。

blocks.en: A scanner window showing an ice belt. Note that, since ice belts are Cosmic Anomalies, they can be warped to immediately (without needing to use scan probes).
blocks.zh: 显示冰矿带的扫描窗口。注意，由于冰矿带属于宇宙异常，可以直接跃迁过去（无需使用扫描探针）。

blocks.en: Ice belts can be found in every region of New Eden, but only in specific systems, and each system contains 1–3 ice belts. Ice belts disappear once mined out, and then respawn 6 hours later. This timer does not work across downtime; there is always an ice belt after downtime—a new one or the leftovers of a not finished one before the downtime. Also unlike asteroid belts, ice belts are a type of Cosmic Anomaly, meaning that they will appear in a different location in the star system every time they respawn, and can be found using a ship's onboard scanner, though they do not require scan probes to find.
blocks.zh: 新伊甸的每个星域都有冰矿带，但只出现在特定星系，每个星系有 1–3 条冰矿带。冰矿带采空后会消失，6 小时后重新刷新。这个计时不跨越服务器维护；维护后总会有一条冰矿带——要么是新刷的，要么是维护前没采完的那条剩余部分。另外，与小行星带不同，冰矿带属于宇宙异常，也就是说每次刷新时都会出现在星系中的不同位置，可以用舰船的内置扫描器找到，无需扫描探针。

blocks.en: Like regular asteroid belts, hostile NPCs periodically spawn in ice belts. The rats spawn ~20 min between waves.
blocks.zh: 和普通小行星带一样，冰矿带中也会定期刷新敌对 NPC。每波海盗 NPC 之间间隔约 20 分钟。

blocks.en: Ice variants
blocks.zh: 冰矿种类

blocks.en: As with ore asteroids, each ice asteroid contains one type of ice (so, for instance, an asteroid called "Blue Ice asteroid" will contain nothing but Blue Ice). There are twelve different types of ice asteroids, split into three categories: faction asteroids, enriched faction asteroids, and standard asteroids.
blocks.zh: 和矿石小行星一样，每颗冰矿小行星只含一种冰矿（例如名为“蓝冰矿小行星”的小行星里只有蓝冰矿）。冰矿小行星共有十二种，分为三类：势力冰矿、富集势力冰矿和标准冰矿。

en: The ice from faction asteroids (which contain Clear Icicle, Glacial Mass, Blue Ice, or White Glaze) refine to small quantities of Heavy Water, Liquid Ozone and Strontium Clathrates, but large amounts of their respective faction's isotope (Helium Isotopes, Hydrogen Isotopes, Oxygen Isotopes, and Nitrogen Isotopes). Each of these asteroid types is only found in the regions of space controlled by their respective faction (so, for instance, Blue Ice asteroids only spawns in Gallente space, and refine to (amongst others) Oxygen Isotopes, which are used to fuel the jump drives on Gallente ships and to manufacture fuel for Gallente POSes).

The ice from enriched faction asteroids (which contain Enriched Clear Icicle, Smooth Glacial Mass, Thick Blue Ice, or Pristine White Glaze) works the same way as regular faction asteroids, but contain more of the same materials. These asteroids are only found in nullsec (in systems controlled by their respective factions), or in the Shattered Ice Fields of Shattered wormhole systems.

The ice from standard asteroids (which contain Glare Crust, Dark Glitter, Gelidus, and Krystallos) contains large quantities of Heavy Water, Liquid Ozone and Strontium Clathrates, but no faction isotopes. These asteroids are only found in low-sec and nullsec, or in the Shattered Ice Fields of Shattered wormhole systems.
zh: 势力冰矿（清冰锥、聚合冰体、蓝冰矿或白釉冰）提炼后得到少量重水、液化臭氧和锶包合物，以及大量对应势力的同位素（氦同位素、氢同位素、氧同位素和氮同位素）。每种冰矿只出现在其对应势力控制的区域（例如蓝冰矿小行星只在盖伦特空间刷新，提炼后得到（包括但不限于）氧同位素，用作盖伦特舰船跳跃引擎的燃料，以及制造盖伦特 POS 的燃料）。
富集势力冰矿（富清冰锥、光滑聚合冰体、厚蓝冰矿或纯净白釉冰）与普通势力冰矿的原理相同，但所含的材料更多。这些冰矿只出现在 00 区（在各自势力控制的星系中），或破碎虫洞星系的破碎冰矿区中。
标准冰矿（电冰体、黑闪冰、加里多斯冰矿和冰晶矿）含有大量重水、液化臭氧和锶包合物，但没有势力同位素。这些冰矿只出现在低安和 00 区，或破碎虫洞星系的破碎冰矿区中。

blocks.zh: 假设提炼技能满级（0% 损耗），冰矿小行星的提炼产出如下：

blocks.en: Like asteroid ore, unrefined ice takes up a large amount of space and can therefore be time-consuming to transport. The best sub-capital ships for transporting ice (and ore) are the Miasmos, a Gallente hauler which can transport up to 63,000 m3 (63 blocks, about two loads from a minimally-skilled Mackinaw, or less than 1.5 loads at max Exhumer skills) of ice, and the Kryos, another Gallente hauler which has a dedicated ice hold (max. 45,000 m3) in a 2021 update. If you need to haul even larger quantities, it may be worth training to fly a freighter (which can hold over ten times as much), or to ship the ice by courier contract.
blocks.zh: 和小行星矿石一样，未提炼的冰矿体积很大，运输起来很费时间。运输冰矿（和矿石）最好的亚旗舰级舰船是米亚莫斯级——一艘盖伦特运载舰，最多可运 63,000 m3 冰矿（63 块，大约相当于技能最低的麦基诺级两舱的量，或采掘者技能满级时不到 1.5 舱）；另一艘是克琉斯级，同为盖伦特运载舰，在 2021 年的更新中获得了专用冰矿舱（最大 45,000 m3）。如果需要运输更大的量，可能值得训练驾驶货舰（容量是其十倍以上），或者通过快递合同运送冰矿。

blocks.en: Ice can also be compressed in Upwell structures with active Standup Reprocessing Facilities, or by an Orca or Rorqual with an Ice Compressor and an active Industrial Core. Compressed ice takes up only 100 m3 per block and, like compressed ore, compressing ice does not change its reprocessing yield.
blocks.zh: 冰矿也可以在启用了屹立提炼设施的昇威建筑中压缩，或者由装有冰矿压缩装置并激活了工业核心的逆戟鲸级或长须鲸级压缩。压缩冰矿每块只占 100 m3，而且和压缩矿石一样，压缩不会改变冰矿的提炼产出。

blocks.en: Ice distribution
blocks.zh: 冰矿分布

blocks.en: See also: Asteroid distribution
blocks.zh: 另请参阅：小行星分布

blocks.en: Like asteroids and ore, different types of ice spawn based on the racial quarters of space. Faction ice (both normal and enriched) will spawn only in that faction's quarter. As with asteroids, more valuable ice spawns at lower security ratings, and each system can spawn all ice types of higher-security systems in the same quarter.
blocks.zh: 和小行星与矿石一样，不同种类的冰矿根据太空的种族象限刷新。势力冰矿（普通和富集）只在该势力的象限刷新。和小行星一样，安全等级越低，刷新的冰矿越值钱，而且每个星系都可能刷新同一象限中更高安全等级星系的所有冰矿种类。

zh: 加里多斯冰矿 冰晶矿 富清冰锥
加里多斯冰矿 冰晶矿 纯净白釉冰
加里多斯冰矿 冰晶矿 厚蓝冰矿
加里多斯冰矿 冰晶矿 光滑聚合冰体

blocks.zh: 高安与低安的特定冰矿带

blocks.en: Clear Icicle Belt • White Glaze Belt • Blue Ice Belt • Glacial Mass Belt
blocks.zh: 清冰锥冰矿带 • 白釉冰冰矿带 • 蓝冰矿冰矿带 • 聚合冰体冰矿带

blocks.en: Specific Ice Belts in Null Security Space
blocks.zh: 00 区的特定冰矿带

blocks.en: Enriched Clear Icicle Belt • Pristine White Glaze Belt • Thick Blue Ice Belt • Smooth Glacial Mass Belt
blocks.zh: 富清冰锥冰矿带 • 纯净白釉冰冰矿带 • 厚蓝冰矿冰矿带 • 光滑聚合冰体冰矿带

blocks.zh: 破碎虫洞星系中的冰矿带

blocks.zh: 破碎冰矿区

blocks.en: Ice harvesting mechanics
blocks.zh: 冰矿采集机制

blocks.en: Main article: Mining
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿

blocks.en: Ice mining works in much the same way as ore mining: equip a ship with ice mining modules, approach and target an ice asteroid, and activate the mining module. At the end of each cycle, one unit of ice will be deposited in your ship's cargo or mining hold. However (unlike ore mining) ice mining modules can only be fit on Mining Barges and Exhumers, and the asteroid mining drones cannot be used. Specialized ice harvesting drones must be used, which also come in T1, T2, Augmented, and Excavator flavors, and also use their own skills: Ice Harvesting Drone Operation, and Ice Harvesting Drone Specialization.
blocks.zh: 冰矿开采的方式与矿石采矿基本相同：给舰船装上冰矿开采装备，接近并锁定一颗冰矿小行星，然后激活采矿装备。在每个周期结束时，一单位冰矿会存入舰船的货舱或矿石舱。不过（与矿石采矿不同）冰矿开采装备只能装在采矿驳船和采掘者上，而且不能使用小行星采矿无人机。必须使用专门的冰矿采集无人机，它同样有 T1、T2、强化型和挖掘者型几种版本，也有自己的技能：冰矿采集无人机操控理论和冰矿采集无人机专业研究。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Main article: Mining skills
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿技能

blocks.en: The core skill for ice mining is the (appropriately named) Ice Harvesting, which reduces the cycle time of ice mining modules by 5% per level. Train this to level V to use the Tech 2 ice miner. Mining Upgrades is needed to install mining upgrade modules (which further decrease the cycle time of ice miners). Lastly, the Mining Barge and/or Exhumers skills are needed to fly ice mining ships; training higher levels of these skills also decreases the cycle time of ice mining modules (depending on the bonuses of the ship being flown). Since most mining modules are fairly CPU-intensive (and fitting ice mining upgrades only makes this worse), you will probably need to train some fitting skills to take full advantage of your ice mining ship.
blocks.zh: 冰矿开采的核心技能是（名副其实的）冰矿采集理论，每级使冰矿开采装备的周期时间减少 5%。练到 V 级才能使用 T2 冰矿采集器。安装采矿改良设备（进一步缩短冰矿采集器的周期时间）需要矿冶提升理论。最后，驾驶冰矿开采舰船需要采矿驳船操作和 / 或采掘者操作技能；把这些技能练到更高等级还能缩短冰矿开采装备的周期时间（取决于所驾驶舰船的加成）。由于大多数采矿装备都相当吃 CPU（装配冰矿采集改良设备只会让情况更糟），你可能需要训练一些装配技能，才能充分发挥冰矿开采舰船的性能。

blocks.en: Ice harvesting ships
blocks.zh: 冰矿采集舰船

blocks.en: Main article: ORE Basic Ship and Skill Overview
blocks.zh: 主条目：联合矿业舰船与技能基础概览

blocks.en: Expedition Frigates
blocks.zh: 勘探护卫舰

blocks.en: The Prospect and the Endurance can both fit Ice Mining Lasers, but the Endurance has bonuses that reduce the cycle duration. They are much more maneuverable and can fit cloaking devices, making them well suited to operating in dangerous wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 掘金者级和永恒者级都能装配冰矿开采激光器，但永恒者级有缩短周期时间的加成。它们机动性强得多，还能装配隐形装置，非常适合在危险的虫洞空间作业。

blocks.en: Mining Barges
blocks.zh: 采矿驳船

blocks.en: All three barges have a 2% reduction in Ice Harvester duration per level of Mining Barge. As with standard mining, each hull is suited for a different style of mining, but none have any particular focus in harvesting ice resources. For example, the Covetor has an extra role bonus to ice mining yield (25% reduction in cycle time and activation cost) and 5% bonus to range, the only one with such a bonus amongst the three barges, but however it also has a fairly small mining hold (7,000 m3), and will fill up fairly quickly. The Procurer and the Retriever have a bonus of 2% each and the same ice mining yield, and each ship has a different strength (the Retriever has a very large mining hold, and the Procurer a very tough tank). As when using these ships for ore mining, the choice depends on your play style. Flying in a dangerous region of space? Use a Procurer. Want to mine for long stretches without returning to a station? Use a Retriever. Want to get the absolute maximum amount of ice you can? Use a Covetor.
blocks.zh: 三种采矿驳船都具有每级采矿驳船操作减少 2% 冰矿采集器周期时间的加成。和普通采矿一样，每种船体适合不同的采矿风格，但都没有专门侧重于冰矿采集。例如，妄想级有额外的冰矿采矿产量特有加成（周期时间和激活消耗减少 25%）以及 5% 的射程加成，是三种驳船中唯一拥有这种加成的，但它的矿石舱相当小（7,000 m3），很快就会装满。猎获级和回旋者级各有 2% 的加成，冰矿采矿产量相同，各有所长（回旋者级的矿石舱很大，猎获级的坦度很硬）。和用这些船开采矿石时一样，选择取决于你的玩法风格。在危险区域活动？用猎获级。想长时间采矿不用回站？用回旋者级。想尽可能采到最多的冰矿？用妄想级。

blocks.en: Exhumers
blocks.zh: 采掘者

blocks.en: Exhumers are straight upgrades from their Mining Barge counterparts, and the same reflections hold true for them. One small difference is that both the Skiff and the Mackinaw get a smaller (2%) reduction to ice harvester cycle time per level of Exhumers (the Hulk gets a 3% reduction per skill level).
blocks.zh: 采掘者是对应采矿驳船的直接升级版，上述考虑同样适用。一个小区别是：轻舟级和麦基诺级每级采掘者操作获得的冰矿采集器周期时间缩减较小（2%）（霍克级每级技能缩减 3%）。

blocks.en: Industrial Command and Capital Industrial Ships
blocks.zh: 工业指挥舰与旗舰级工业舰

blocks.en: With the release of the Ascension update, the Orca, Rorqual, and the newly-introduced Porpoise all have bonuses to ice harvesting drone cycle time. As a result, these ships have become viable ice harvesting platforms post-Ascension.
blocks.zh: 随着飞升（Ascension）更新的发布，逆戟鲸级、长须鲸级以及新推出的海豚级都获得了冰矿采集无人机周期时间加成。因此，飞升之后这些船也成了可行的冰矿采集平台。

blocks.en: Drones
blocks.zh: 无人机

blocks.en: Main article: Drones
blocks.zh: 主条目：无人机

blocks.en: The skill Ice Harvesting Drone Operation reduces cycle time by 5% per skill level. Ice harvesting drones do exist, and are in fact the only way for the Porpoise, Orca, and Rorqual to harvest ice. However, ice harvesting drones use considerably more bandwidth and drone bay space than their ore mining counterparts (50 vs 5 Mbits/s / m3), so most ships can only field a single drone of this type and the Rorqual, with the maximum amount of bandwidth (125 Mbit/s) can only utilize two at a time.
blocks.zh: 技能冰矿采集无人机操控理论每级减少 5% 周期时间。冰矿采集无人机确实存在，而且实际上是海豚级、逆戟鲸级和长须鲸级采集冰矿的唯一方式。不过，冰矿采集无人机占用的带宽和无人机舱空间比矿石采矿无人机多得多（50 对 5 Mbit/s / m3），所以大多数船只能放出一架这种无人机，而带宽最大（125 Mbit/s）的长须鲸级一次也只能使用两架。

blocks.en: The Rorqual also has access to the powerful ice-harvesting variant of the Excavator drone. Unlike regular ice harvesting drones, Excavators only require 25 Mbit/s of bandwidth, allowing a Rorqual to field a full flight of five. Excavators have phenomenal ice harvesting capabilities, with a cycle time more than 100 seconds faster than normal ice harvesting drones, though they also move at half the speed.
blocks.zh: 长须鲸级还能使用强大的冰矿采集型挖掘者无人机。与普通冰矿采集无人机不同，挖掘者无人机只需 25 Mbit/s 带宽，长须鲸级可以放出整整五架。挖掘者无人机的冰矿采集能力惊人，周期时间比普通冰矿采集无人机快 100 多秒，不过移动速度只有一半。

blocks.en: Improving yield
blocks.zh: 提高产量

blocks.en: Main article: Mining yield
blocks.zh: 主条目：采矿产量

blocks.en: In contrast with ore mining, all ice mining modules mine exactly one unit (1000 m3) of ice per cycle; therefore, the only way to increase your mining efficiency is to decrease your modules' cycle time. This can be done by training skills (see above), installing more advanced ice mining and mining upgrade modules, fitting Ice Harvester Accelerator rigs, flying more advanced ships (Exhumers instead of Mining Barges), or using implants (the IH-100x Inherent Implants 'Yeti' Ice Harvesting series). Additionally, if you are in a fleet, you can receive further bonuses through Command bursts.
blocks.zh: 与矿石采矿不同，所有冰矿开采装备每个周期都恰好开采一单位（1000 m3）冰矿；因此，提高采矿效率的唯一方法是缩短装备的周期时间。具体可以通过训练技能（见上文）、安装更高级的冰矿开采装备和采矿改良设备、装配冰矿采集器加速器改装件、驾驶更高级的舰船（用采掘者代替采矿驳船），或使用植入体（IH-100x 天赋植体 雪人 冰矿采集系列）来实现。此外，如果你在舰队中，还可以通过指挥脉冲波获得更多加成。

blocks.en: While each bonus may seem small, when taken together they can make a significant difference:
blocks.zh: 虽然每项加成看起来都不大，但叠加在一起效果非常显著：

blocks.en: If the miner then spends some time training their Mining Barge and Ice Harvesting skills to level IV, the miner will have lowered their cycle time to 2 minutes and 13 seconds, an improvement of about 12%. Wanting to improve the yield further, the miner can then install two Ice Harvest Upgrade modules on their Covetor (with some training to Mining Upgrades IV), which drops the cycle time to 2 minutes.
blocks.zh: 如果矿工再花些时间把采矿驳船操作和冰矿采集理论练到 IV 级，周期时间就会降到 2 分 13 秒，提升约 12%。想进一步提高产量的话，矿工可以在妄想级上装两个冰矿采集能力提升器（需要练到矿冶提升理论 IV），周期时间降到 2 分钟。

blocks.en: The miner can then upgrade the ship to a Hulk (with some training to Exhumers IV), and installs an Ice Harvester Accelerator rig for good measure, which brings the cycle time down to 1 minute and 53 seconds. Going for broke, the miner upgrades all the modules to their Tech 2 variants, adds a third Ice Harvest Upgrade II and trains their skills to level V, dropping their cycle time down to 1 minute 17 seconds, for a total reduction of 48%.
blocks.zh: 接下来矿工可以把船升级为霍克级（需要练到采掘者操作 IV），再顺手装上一个冰矿采集器加速器改装件，周期时间降到 1 分 53 秒。如果不惜血本，把所有装备升级为 T2 版本，再加装第三个冰矿采集能力提升器 II，并把技能练到 V 级，周期时间就能降到 1 分 17 秒，总共缩短 48%。

blocks.en: As mining ice often turns into a race, with large number of miners competing to mine as much ice before the belt is emptied, having short cycle times can be an advantage beyond simply mining more ice in a given period of time. This allows you to beat your competition to those last few pieces of ice in a belt (as, if two miners are attempting to mine the same asteroid with only one unit of ice left, whoever finishes their cycle first gets that block of ice, and the other gets nothing). Using a survey scanner can be very helpful, as you can see how much ice is left in each asteroid.
blocks.zh: 由于采冰常常变成一场比赛，大批矿工争相在冰矿带被采空前采到尽可能多的冰矿，周期短的好处不止是在一定时间内采到更多冰矿。它能让你在冰矿带最后几块冰上抢先竞争对手（如果两名矿工在开采同一颗只剩一单位冰矿的小行星，谁先完成周期谁就得到这块冰，另一个人什么也得不到）。使用勘测扫描器会很有帮助，因为你能看到每颗小行星还剩多少冰矿。

blocks.en: Tactics
blocks.zh: 战术

blocks.en: Because of the popularity of systems that contain ice anomalies, they have become targets of regular and perpetual ganking activities. The following tactics may be useful in particular by Ice Miners:
blocks.zh: 由于含有冰矿异常的星系很热门，它们已成为经常性、持续性自杀式攻击的目标。以下战术可能对冰矿矿工特别有用：

en: Ensure that once you warp in to a site, you start your ship moving away from the warp in point. This is where gankers are likely to appear.
Use bookmarks to your advantage. Sensible use of safe spots can make ice mining much safer.
Make sure you are always moving. Gankers may be tempted by still ships, which may be an indication that the pilot is not at their keyboard.
Try to be aligned at all times, ideally to your safe spot. Provided you are moving at 75% of your maximum speed you will be able to warp off almost immediately if a ganker appears.
If you know the names or corporations of local gankers, set them as "terrible" standing in your contacts list. This will ensure that they stand out in local.
zh: 跃迁进站点后，一定要立刻让船离开跃迁落点。自杀式攻击者很可能会在那里出现。
善用书签。合理使用安全点可以让冰矿开采安全得多。
确保你的船一直在移动。静止的船可能会引起自杀式攻击者的注意，因为这可能表明飞行员不在电脑前。
尽量时刻保持对准，最好是对准你的安全点。只要你以最大速度的 75% 移动，一旦有自杀式攻击者出现，你几乎可以立即跃迁离开。
如果你知道本地自杀式攻击者的名字或军团，在联系人列表中把他们设为“极差”声望。这样他们在本地频道中会很显眼。
